A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 20-page CharTide paper, including Appendices A–D. Text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison; pages 2–20 render identically.

before.justification: v1 reports original CharTide benchmark results, ablations, training analyses and appendix experiments, including OOD evaluations and data-contamination analysis.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and the appendices, including benchmark comparisons, ablations and OOD evaluations.

M1.justification: The tri-perspective SFT streams, Inquiry-Driven RL procedure, frozen Inspector, visual reward and GRPO optimization are unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Training-data coverage and evaluation tasks are unchanged, including ChartMimic, Plot2Code, ChartX, Customized Mimic and the Seaborn OOD examples in Appendix A.1.

E2.justification: The comparator sets remain identical throughout the benchmark, reward and OOD comparisons. Table 1 retains the same proprietary, Qwen and chart-specific baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain the same model sizes, training settings, evaluation samples, judges and metrics, including full-test-set normalization for Plot2Code.

E4.justification: The SFT and reward ablations, reward-hacking examination, contamination checks, information-asymmetry analysis and qualitative examples are identical, including the appendix analyses.

E5.justification: Appendix A retains the mean of three independent measurements for ChartMimic and the paired t-test over 600 samples in Table 6. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and the plotted and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains CharTide-8B's ChartMimic execution, low-level and high-level scores of 97.3, 83.0 and 92.7.

T1.justification: The semantic and visual reward definitions in Equations (1)–(2), their combination and accompanying mathematical reasoning are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about tri-perspective supervision, inquiry-driven verification and performance relative to open-source and proprietary models.

C2.justification: Interpretations of data homogeneity, reward reliability and contamination results are unchanged. The limitations concerning larger backbones and broader editing, style-transfer and customization tasks are also retained.

D1.justification: The hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures, filtering thresholds, data-construction instructions and generation prompts remain identical. Code and data access information does not change.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works and bibliography are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to existing chart-to-code methods and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

P1.justification: Page 1 changes the first author's email from zhengxx@nju.edu.cn, expressed within a grouped address, to zhengxx@smail.nju.edu.cn and spells out the remaining addresses. The arXiv version/date stamp updates; body wording and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–11, Tables 1–7, captions, placement and page layout are unchanged. Rendered differences are confined to the first-page contact line and arXiv version/date text.

improvement.justification: v2 updates author contact information and the arXiv version/date stamp. Research content, experimental evidence, limitations and reproducibility disclosures remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, leaving overall paper quality materially unchanged.
